chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said: “Whoever obeys his wife, Allah will cast him down upon his nostrils in the Fire.”
So it was said: “What is that obedience?” He said: “She calls him to lamentation gatherings, wedding festivities, bathhouses, and wearing thin garments, and he answers her.”
ai.seo_question: What kind of obedience to one’s wife is condemned in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against obeying one’s wife in matters that lead to disobedience to Allah. It specifically mentions social settings and forms of dress associated here with impropriety, and ties such compliance to severe punishment in the afterlife.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.241 - Imam (as) said: 'Whoever obeys his wife (in matters of disobedience) will be thrown by Allah (swt), the Exalted, on his face in the Fire.'

It was said: 'What kind of obedience is that?'
Imam (as) said: "When She invites him to go to congregation of lamentations to extravagant festivities (weddings), or going to public bathhouses, and or to wear delicate (thin/revealing) clothing; and he approves it for her."
